title: Lyon 2021 Stages D-E: intersection table + quad face emission
description:
PATCH-64 split into per-stage tickets. Stages D+E port metriko's gen_intersection_table + visualize_split_mesh (gen_qgp_mesh.h + visualize_qgp_mesh.h, ~180 LOC).

Stage D: given arcs1 (split arcs from side 0 to 2) and arcs2 (side 1 to 3), build (arcs1.size()+2) x (arcs2.size()+2) intersection table where (i,j) is the 3D position at the intersection of arc1[i] and arc2[j].

Stage E: emit (rows-1) x (cols-1) quad faces from the table, accumulate into per-patch ArrayMesh.

Depends on: PATCH-65 (Stage C).
definition-of-done: lyon2021/IntersectionTable.java + lyon2021/QuadAssembler.java together produce ArrayMesh from per-Tpatch arcs1/arcs2 lists. Unit test on synthetic patch passes.
testing-plan: 1. Synthetic 4-cycle patch with 2 split arcs each direction (3x3 table = 4 quads). 2. Verify quad count = (arcs1+1)*(arcs2+1).
